arms.role: incumbent control rerun on strict CUDA
arms.architecture: RBF-PIKAN [2,16,16,1], 11 fixed Gaussian edge bases, width 0.21, SiLU base
arms.notes: Recreates the declared EXP-0003 model geometry and hard transform; the old EXP-0003 device field is discrepant and its score is context only.
Same PDE, hard transform, point pools and evaluator. This is a matched-time Adam-only adaptation, not a reproduction of the tutorial's full 40,000-Adam-step plus L-BFGS recipe.

training.hardware: Kaggle GPU T4x2; one isolated process per T4, paired arms run concurrently
training.optimizer: Adam only, learning rate 0.001; the same elapsed-time cap applies to both arms
training.pool_policy: per-seed scrambled Sobol, shared byte-identical coordinates between arms
training.parallel_schedule: for each seed, run RBF and MLP simultaneously on separate T4s; process seed pairs sequentially
training.checkpoint_selection: final state at cap; no selection by reference field, held-out field, or FEATFLOW/published scores

reference.method: GPU torch.float64 finite-difference method-of-lines with explicit RK4; independent of training and evaluation data
reference.acceptance: candidate only; the field score stays blocked unless the generated grid passes gates and is independently reviewed

evaluation.primary: relative weighted space-time L2 on the single GPU-generated reference grid; spatial and temporal trapezoid weights
secondary: relative spatial L2 at every saved time and its maximum
held-out PDE residual RMS on a fixed 16384-point Sobol pool
evaluation.reference_failure_behavior: write reference_status.json with blocked status and stop before computing field scores

stop_rule.stop_each_run: first of 600 synchronized elapsed seconds, non-finite loss/gradient, pair deadline, or fatal runtime failure
stop_rule.stop_campaign: hard script wall deadline; reference hard cap 2700s; scoring allowance 600s; stop before a new seed pair if its run cap cannot fit
stop_rule.t4x2_quota_accounting: one hour of T4x2 Kaggle session runtime charges one quota hour; active device allocation is separately reported
stop_rule.optional_smoke: 120 seconds per arm; consume from the safety reserve, never add beyond the 2-hour session cap
stop_rule.if_reference_gates_fail: do not publish field scores; end the campaign or report only non-field diagnostics

provenance.execution_status: not run; no Kaggle upload, preflight, validation, training, or reference solve performed
